title: Replace dark navy blue theme with stunning light aesthetic theme

requirements.text: Replace all dark navy blue colors with soft warm ivory/pearl cream background (#F8F5F0) throughout the entire application
acceptanceCriteria: All pages display #F8F5F0 as the primary background color
No dark navy blue backgrounds remain anywhere in the application
Background color is consistent across desktop, mobile, and tablet viewports

requirements.text: Apply gradient backgrounds to section elements using linear-gradient(135deg, #F8F5F0 0%, #F5F0E6 100%)
acceptanceCriteria: Hero sections, category sections, and feature sections display the specified gradient
Gradient maintains consistent appearance across all screen sizes

requirements.text: Update primary accent color to antique gold (#C9A96E) for buttons, borders, highlights, and interactive elements
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons use #C9A96E as background color
Interactive elements and borders use antique gold for visual emphasis
Hover states deepen the gold color and add subtle lift + glow effects

requirements.text: Apply secondary accent color of muted blush rose gold (#E8C0C8) to category titles and decorative elements

quotes: Secondary accent: muted blush rose gold #E8C0C8

acceptanceCriteria: Category and special titles display #E8C0C8 color
Secondary decorative elements use the blush rose gold accent appropriately

requirements.text: Update primary text color to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) and secondary text to warm taupe gray (#5C4B51)
acceptanceCriteria: All primary text (body, descriptions, labels) displays in #1A1A1A
Secondary text (captions, meta info) displays in #5C4B51
Text contrast meets WCAG accessibility standards on light backgrounds

requirements.text: Style buttons with antique gold background (#C9A96E), dark text, and hover effects with deeper gold, lift animation, and glow

quotes: Buttons: antique gold bg #C9A96E, dark text, hover deeper gold + lift + glow

acceptanceCriteria: All CTA buttons display #C9A96E background with dark text
Hover state darkens gold color and adds subtle transform lift
Hover state includes a soft glow effect around button edges

requirements.text: Style product cards and content cards with pure white background (#FFFFFF), 1px gold border (#C9A96E), and soft shadow

quotes: Cards: white #FFFFFF with gold border 1px + soft shadow

acceptanceCriteria: Product cards display white background with exactly 1px gold border
Cards include subtle box-shadow for depth
Card styling is consistent across product grid, quick view, and detail pages

requirements.text: Update heading font to Playfair Display ExtraBold with antique gold color (#C9A96E)
acceptanceCriteria: All h1, h2, h3 elements use Playfair Display ExtraBold
Heading text displays in #C9A96E color
Font loads correctly from Google Fonts with proper fallbacks

requirements.text: Apply Great Vibes Regular font to category titles and special decorative titles with color #E8C0C8
acceptanceCriteria: Category navigation titles use Great Vibes Regular script font
Special decorative titles display in #E8C0C8 blush rose gold
Font provides elegant script aesthetic without sacrificing readability

requirements.text: Set body text font to Lora Regular with deep charcoal color (#1A1A1A)
acceptanceCriteria: All paragraph text, descriptions, and body content use Lora Regular
Body text displays in #1A1A1A color for optimal readability
Font renders consistently across all browsers

requirements.text: Apply Montserrat Bold font to all button text and call-to-action elements
acceptanceCriteria: Button text uses Montserrat Bold font family
CTA elements display clear, bold typography
Button text remains legible on antique gold backgrounds

requirements.text: Remove all media query overrides for colors, fonts, and backgrounds to force identical light theme appearance across desktop, laptop, and mobile viewports

quotes: Force consistency: laptop/mobile pe same look (no media-query overrides for colors/fonts/bg)

acceptanceCriteria: Color palette remains identical on all screen sizes
Font families and weights are consistent across all viewports
Background colors and gradients do not change based on media queries
Only layout and spacing adjustments are allowed in responsive breakpoints

requirements.text: Audit and eliminate all instances of dark navy blue colors from the entire codebase, replacing with the light aesthetic palette
acceptanceCriteria: Search codebase confirms zero hex codes matching dark blue patterns (#001f3f, #003366, #000080, etc.)
Visual inspection shows no dark blue elements on any page
Theme switcher (if present) only shows light theme option

requirements.text: Preserve all existing functionality including login/OTP flow, Internet Identity, profile dashboard, cart icon, addresses, orders, and product catalog while applying light theme
acceptanceCriteria: Login and OTP verification continue to work without errors
Internet Identity authentication remains functional
Profile dashboard displays user details, addresses, and orders correctly
Cart icon shows accurate item count and cart panel functions properly
Product catalog loads and displays all products with new theme applied

constraints: Do not modify backend Motoko code or data models
Do not change routing, authentication logic, or business logic
Do not alter layout structure, component hierarchy, or page organization
Do not edit immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or components/ui directory
Maintain existing accessibility features and WCAG compliance
Preserve all hover effects, animations, and interactive behaviors
nonGoals: Adding new features or functionality beyond theme update
Restructuring component architecture or file organization
Changing product data, categories, or backend schema
Implementing dark mode toggle or theme switching
Adding new pages, routes, or navigation elements
Modifying authentication flows or user management logic
